name: Red V Foods
old_description: Red V Foods’ dedicated teams of experts are ready to assist you with your company’s needs. We are a full-service distributor and manufacturer of coconut products and a leading contract packaging partner for private label retailers. Our SQF-certified facility and skilled production crew adhere to the strictest compliance standards. With over 100,000 sq. ft. of climate-controlled warehousing and reliable third-party logistics partners, we work to ensure your company stays on target.
about:
Red V Foods operates from Buford, Georgia, where its history traces back to the mid-1800s. The company's founders developed a desiccation process to prevent spoilage of coconut goods during long voyages from Asia. Today, Red V Foods is a subsidiary of Axelum Resources Corp., a Philippines-based manufacturer of coconut ingredients.

The company manufactures and distributes a range of coconut products including desiccated, sweetened, and toasted coconut, coconut milk powder, cream, milk, and oil. It runs an 11,000-square-foot manufacturing and distribution facility alongside more than 100,000 square feet of climate-controlled warehousing. A team of over 40 employees handles sourcing, manufacturing, co-packing, private labeling, and oil-filling services, supported by Axelum's 4,000-plus workforce in the Philippines.

Red V Foods serves food and beverage brands, food manufacturers, food service providers, distributors, and retailers across North and South America, including the U.S., Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and Chile. It acts as a co-packing partner for several large retail brands, offering custom formulation and packaging.

The company emphasizes a direct supply chain through its parent company, eliminating middlemen, and maintains SQF certification with GMP and HACCP programs. Its facility is also certified organic, non-GMO, kosher, and halal. Axelum's laboratories hold ISO 17025 accreditation, and the parent company pursues near-zero-waste manufacturing and community development programs.
